hero.title: CREATING SUSTAINABLE ENERGY OF TOMORROW
hero.description: Bio Trend Energy Private Limited (BTE) is an Indian company working on advanced biomass pellets, waste clean-energy solutions and innovations that aim to reduce GHG emissions and improve the environment. Our long-term goal is a cleaner environment through the replacement of fossil fuel in industrial and other sectors.

about.title: Bio Trend Energy Private Limited
about.description: In a continuous effort toward the global sustainable-energy transition, Bio Trend Energy has partnered with energy enthusiasts around the world and continues to build new partnerships.
about.story: In the renewable-energy domain, BTE undertakes farmer and stakeholder training, works with partners, and carries out activities including biomass-pellet manufacturing.
bullets: Replacing fossil fuel in industrial and other sectors
